sources.title: JAX Image Tools
sources.snippet: WHAT IS JAX IMAGE TOOLS: A cloud-native application that serves as a platform to develop and deploy both conventional and ML/AI image analysis workflows. It is developed in the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with microservices and the workflows are run on Temporal.io. Users can perform the image analysis tasks in a web browser, which makes it easier to learn and use. Get started with JAX Image ...
